text:
leah: Starting a short, targeted access review now (2pm PT). Scope: admin roles flagged by last-login > 45d, KMS grants with cross-project principals, and service accounts that only appear in nightly cron jobs. Objective: create evidence tickets and tag for manual owner validation. No automatic deletes without explicit approvals.
tom: Thanks. Can we also priority-sort keys that have external principals (aws:*, google-external accounts)? Those are higher risk.
leah: Yes — filter external principals into the high-risk bucket. We'll surface them first in the ticket queue.
ayon: FYI, our audit logs retention policy means recent-use queries might miss activity older than 90d for archived projects. Add a column to mark "log_coverage: partial" so reviewers know to ask for extra evidence.
sec-bot: recert-run 2026-05-04T14:00:00Z initiated by leah. Scanning IAM bindings, KMS grants, and service-account activity. Report will post here when collection completes.
claire: Quick checklist suggestion: 1) mark SA keys used by periodic batch jobs with cron tag; 2) for any SA with >1 active grant to prod, flag for paired-owner review; 3) add "do-not-revoke" label for known infra SAs until review done.
leah: Good idea. We'll add "cron-svc" and "paired-owner" tags and ensure the pipeline never sets revoke=true if do-not-revoke exists.
tom: Example query for last-authored decrypt events (stackdriver):
```
resource.type="kms_key" protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"
| jsonPayload | stats latest(timestamp) by protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail as last_user, resource.labels.key_name as key
| where timestamp < timestamp_sub(now(), interval 45 day)
```
Use this to triage stale keys.
ayon: Also check for cross-project grants where the principal email domain != org domain. Those tend to be external apps.
sec-bot: collection complete at 2026-05-04T14:07:32Z. Summary: 5,980 IAM bindings scanned, 127 KMS grants, 41 SAs only used by nightly crons, 64 admin roles with last-login >45d. Creating 205 owner-evidence tickets.
infra-oncall: Note on pager risk: owner outreach emails sometimes generate alerts when the owner is oncall. Recommend adding subject prefix "[Access Recert]" and a 1-hour snooze header for oncall addresses.
claire: I'll add a template for owners: include last-use snippet, links to quick remediation steps, and a one-click "I own this" response which auto-closes the ticket.
leah: Plan: 1) owner tickets created now 2) 5-day response window 3) auto-escalate to infra-oncall if no owner response 4) final manual revoke window 7 days after escalation (only by oncall). Volunteers: @claire for owner template, @ayon for log-coverage notes, @tom for prioritization rules.
ayon: I'll add a new docs section: /runbooks/access-recert/external-grants.md describing reasoning for external-principal prioritization and mitigation steps.
tom: I'll prepare a one-off hotlist of the top 25 high-risk KMS grants and DM infra-oncall for pre-review before the email blast.
sec-bot: tickets created: recert-20260504-205 tickets. Tags: high-risk-external (32), cron-svc (41), partial-log (18).
leah: Thanks team. After owner responses come in we should run a dry-run revoke report (no changes) to show what would be removed if we proceeded; post-run in this thread for signoff. :thumbsup:
